column1: record|记录|1|Keep a {record} of your daily progress.|记录你每天的进步。
identity|身份|1|The officer checked my {identity} at the gate.|警官在大门处检查了我的身份。
security|安全|1|The company improved the {security} of its network.|公司加强了网络安全。
permission|许可|1|You need {permission} to enter this room.|进入这个房间需要许可。
repair|修理|1|They will {repair} the broken equipment tomorrow.|他们明天将修理损坏的设备。
evidence|证据|1|We need more {evidence} before making a decision.|做决定之前，我们需要更多证据。
confirm|确认|1|Please {confirm} your arrival time by email.|请通过电子邮件确认你的到达时间。
shelter|避难所|1|The family found a safe {shelter} from the storm.|这家人找到了一个安全的避难所来躲避暴风雨。
available|可获得的|1|The book is {available} in the library.|图书馆里可以借到这本书。
prevent|防止|1|Regular exercise can {prevent} many health problems.|经常锻炼可以预防许多健康问题。
solution|解决办法|1|They finally found a {solution} to the problem.|他们终于找到了解决这个问题的办法。
responsible|负责的|1|She is {responsible} for the new project.|她负责这个新项目。
patient|耐心的|1|The teacher was very {patient} with the students.|老师对学生很有耐心。
schedule|日程表|1|Check the {schedule} before leaving home.|出门前查看一下日程表。
improve|改善|1|Reading every day can {improve} your vocabulary.|每天阅读可以扩大你的词汇量。
support|支持|1|Her friends will {support} her decision.|她的朋友们会支持她的决定。
challenge|挑战|1|Learning a new language is a real {challenge}.|学习一门新语言确实是一项挑战。
purpose|目的|1|What is the {purpose} of this experiment?|这个实验的目的是什么？
benefit|益处|1|One {benefit} of walking is better health.|步行的一个益处是改善健康。
experience|经历|1|The trip was an unforgettable {experience}.|这次旅行是一段难忘的经历。
opportunity|机会|1|This job is a great {opportunity} to learn.|这份工作是一个很好的学习机会。
environment|环境|1|We should protect the natural {environment}.|我们应该保护自然环境。
reduce|减少|1|We must {reduce} the amount of plastic waste.|我们必须减少塑料垃圾的数量。
increase|增加|1|The new service may {increase} ticket sales.|这项新服务可能会增加票务销量。
require|需要|1|Some jobs {require} years of training.|有些工作需要多年的培训。
provide|提供|1|The school will {provide} free meals.|学校将提供免费餐食。
consider|考虑|1|Please {consider} all the options carefully.|请认真考虑所有选项。
suggest|建议|1|I would {suggest} a different approach.|我建议采用另一种方法。
explain|解释|1|Can you {explain} how this machine works?|你能解释一下这台机器如何运作吗？
compare|比较|1|You should {compare} the prices before buying.|购买之前应该比较价格。
develop|发展|1|Children need time to {develop} new skills.|孩子们需要时间来培养新技能。
achieve|实现|1|Hard work helps us {achieve} our goals.|努力工作有助于我们实现目标。
avoid|避免|1|Try to {avoid} making the same mistake.|尽量避免犯同样的错误。
prepare|准备|1|We need to {prepare} for the meeting.|我们需要为会议做准备。
accept|接受|1|She decided to {accept} the offer.|她决定接受这份邀约。
refuse|拒绝|1|You may {refuse} the invitation politely.|你可以礼貌地拒绝邀请。
notice|注意到|1|Did you {notice} the change in his voice?|你注意到他声音的变化了吗？
realize|意识到|1|I did not {realize} how late it was.|我没有意识到时间已经这么晚了。
protect|保护|1|These rules help {protect} workers.|这些规定有助于保护工人。
replace|替换|1|We need to {replace} the old battery.|我们需要更换旧电池。
manage|管理|1|It is difficult to {manage} a large team.|管理一个大团队很困难。
request|请求|1|The manager approved our {request} for more time.|经理批准了我们延长时间的请求。
decision|决定|1|It was a difficult {decision} for the family.|对这家人来说，这是一个艰难的决定。
attention|注意力|1|Please pay {attention} to the instructions.|请注意这些说明。
method|方法|1|The team tested a new {method} of teaching.|团队测试了一种新的教学方法。
quality|质量|1|The {quality} of the product has improved.|产品的质量有所提高。
knowledge|知识|1|Travel can broaden our {knowledge} of the world.|旅行可以拓宽我们对世界的认识。
ordinary|普通的|1|It seemed like an {ordinary} day at first.|起初，这似乎只是普通的一天。
necessary|必要的|1|Good sleep is {necessary} for our health.|良好的睡眠对健康是必要的。
efficient|高效的|2|The new system is more {efficient} than the old one.|新系统比旧系统效率更高。
alternative|替代选择|2|Cycling is a healthy {alternative} to driving.|骑自行车是开车之外的一种健康选择。
assistance|帮助|2|The visitors asked for {assistance} at the station.|游客在车站寻求帮助。
maintenance|维护|2|The machine needs regular {maintenance}.|这台机器需要定期维护。
investigation|调查|2|The police began an {investigation} into the incident.|警方开始调查这起事件。
restore|恢复|2|Engineers worked all night to {restore} power.|工程师们通宵工作以恢复供电。
equipment|设备|2|All the {equipment} must be checked before use.|所有设备在使用前都必须检查。
circuit|电路|2|A damaged {circuit} caused the failure.|一处损坏的电路导致了故障。
priority|优先事项|2|Safety is our top {priority}.|安全是我们的首要任务。
assumption|假设|2|The argument is based on a false {assumption}.|这个论点建立在一个错误的假设之上。
verify|核实|2|Please {verify} the information before sharing it.|分享信息之前，请先核实。
recover|找回|2|She managed to {recover} the missing files.|她成功找回了丢失的文件。
dispute|争议|2|The two sides settled the {dispute} peacefully.|双方和平解决了争议。
concern|担忧|2|Parents expressed {concern} about road safety.|家长们表达了对道路安全的担忧。
frustrated|沮丧的|2|He felt {frustrated} after several failed attempts.|多次尝试失败后，他感到沮丧。
reliable|可靠的|2|We need a {reliable} source of information.|我们需要一个可靠的信息来源。
accurate|准确的|2|The report provides {accurate} figures.|这份报告提供了准确的数据。
essential|必不可少的|2|Clean water is {essential} for human life.|清洁的水对人类生命必不可少。
potential|潜在的|2|The researchers identified a {potential} risk.|研究人员发现了一项潜在风险。
practical|实用的|2|She offered some {practical} advice.|她提供了一些实用的建议。
flexible|灵活的|2|The company offers {flexible} working hours.|公司提供灵活的工作时间。
reasonable|合理的|2|They agreed on a {reasonable} price.|他们商定了一个合理的价格。
significant|显著的|2|The study found a {significant} difference.|研究发现了显著的差异。
individual|个体|2|Each {individual} has different needs.|每个人都有不同的需求。
community|社区|2|The local {community} supported the project.|当地社区支持了这个项目。
resource|资源|2|Water is a valuable natural {resource}.|水是一种宝贵的自然资源。
consequence|后果|2|We must consider every possible {consequence}.|我们必须考虑每一种可能的后果。
advantage|优势|2|Experience gives her an {advantage} in the competition.|经验使她在竞争中具有优势。
disadvantage|劣势|2|Distance is the main {disadvantage} of this location.|距离远是这个地点的主要劣势。
approach|处理方法|2|The teacher tried a different {approach}.|老师尝试了另一种方法。
strategy|策略|2|They developed a new marketing {strategy}.|他们制定了一项新的营销策略。
attitude|态度|2|His positive {attitude} helped the team.|他积极的态度帮助了团队。
confidence|信心|2|Practice can build your {confidence}.|练习可以增强你的信心。
motivation|动力|2|Her main {motivation} is a desire to help others.|她的主要动力是帮助他人的愿望。
achievement|成就|2|Finishing the project was a major {achievement}.|完成这个项目是一项重大成就。
competition|竞争|2|The market faces strong {competition}.|市场面临激烈的竞争。
communication|交流|2|Good {communication} is important in a team.|良好的沟通在团队中很重要。
contribution|贡献|2|She made a valuable {contribution} to the research.|她为这项研究作出了宝贵的贡献。
requirement|要求|2|Experience is a basic {requirement} for this job.|经验是这份工作的基本要求。
responsibility|责任|2|Protecting the environment is a shared {responsibility}.|保护环境是共同的责任。
determine|确定|2|The results will {determine} our next step.|这些结果将决定我们的下一步行动。
establish|建立|2|They plan to {establish} a new research center.|他们计划建立一个新的研究中心。
maintain|维持|2|It is important to {maintain} a healthy balance.|保持健康的平衡很重要。
promote|促进|2|The program aims to {promote} public awareness.|这个项目旨在提高公众意识。
evaluate|评价|2|Experts will {evaluate} the new treatment.|专家们将评估这种新疗法。
analyze|分析|2|We need to {analyze} the data carefully.|我们需要仔细分析数据。
indicate|表明|2|The results {indicate} that the plan is working.|结果表明，这个计划正在发挥作用。
involve|涉及|2|The project will {involve} several departments.|这个项目将涉及多个部门。
respond|回应|2|The company promised to {respond} quickly.|公司承诺迅速回应。
adapt|适应|3|People must {adapt} to changes in the workplace.|人们必须适应工作环境中的变化。
allocate|分配|3|The council will {allocate} more funds to education.|委员会将向教育分配更多资金。
anticipate|预期|3|We {anticipate} a rise in demand next year.|我们预计明年的需求将上升。
assess|评估|3|The team will {assess} the damage after the storm.|团队将在暴风雨后评估损失。
assure|使确信|3|Let me {assure} you that your data is safe.|我向你保证，你的数据是安全的。
attribute|把……归因于|3|They {attribute} their success to teamwork.|他们把成功归因于团队合作。
comprehensive|全面的|3|The report offers a {comprehensive} review.|这份报告提供了全面的回顾。
consistent|一致的|3|The evidence is {consistent} with the theory.|证据与该理论一致。
conventional|传统的|3|The new method differs from {conventional} practice.|这种新方法不同于传统做法。
controversial|有争议的|3|The proposal remains highly {controversial}.|这项提议仍然存在很大争议。
crucial|至关重要的|3|Trust plays a {crucial} role in cooperation.|信任在合作中起着至关重要的作用。
decline|下降|3|The population may {decline} over time.|人口可能会随着时间推移而减少。
demonstrate|证明|3|These findings {demonstrate} the value of early action.|这些发现证明了及早行动的价值。
derive|获得|3|Many people {derive} pleasure from reading.|许多人从阅读中获得乐趣。
diminish|减弱|3|The noise began to {diminish} after midnight.|午夜过后，噪声开始减弱。
diverse|多样的|3|The city has a {diverse} population.|这座城市的人口构成多样。
eliminate|消除|3|Better planning can {eliminate} unnecessary delays.|更好的规划可以消除不必要的延误。
emphasize|强调|3|The report will {emphasize} the need for reform.|报告将强调改革的必要性。
enhance|增强|3|The training aims to {enhance} practical skills.|这项培训旨在提高实践技能。
excessive|过度的|3|Avoid {excessive} use of social media.|避免过度使用社交媒体。
feasible|可行的|3|The experts believe the plan is {feasible}.|专家认为这个计划是可行的。
fluctuate|波动|3|Prices may {fluctuate} during the season.|价格可能在这一季节有所波动。
fundamental|根本的|3|There is a {fundamental} difference between the two ideas.|这两个想法之间存在根本差异。
implement|实施|3|The school will {implement} the policy next term.|学校将于下学期实施这项政策。
imply|暗示|3|His comments seem to {imply} disagreement.|他的评论似乎暗示了不同意见。
inevitable|不可避免的|3|Some changes are {inevitable} as society develops.|随着社会发展，有些变化是不可避免的。
innovation|创新|3|The industry depends on continuous {innovation}.|这个行业依赖持续创新。
integrate|整合|3|We need to {integrate} these services into one system.|我们需要把这些服务整合到一个系统中。
interpret|解释含义|3|People may {interpret} the message differently.|人们可能会对这条信息作出不同的解读。
justify|证明……合理|3|The benefits do not {justify} the high cost.|这些益处不足以证明高昂的成本是合理的。
nevertheless|然而|3|The task was difficult; {nevertheless}, they continued.|任务很困难，然而他们仍继续进行。
objective|客观的|3|Researchers should remain {objective} when judging evidence.|研究人员判断证据时应保持客观。
obstacle|障碍|3|Lack of funding is the main {obstacle}.|缺乏资金是主要障碍。
perceive|感知|3|People {perceive} risk in different ways.|人们以不同的方式感知风险。
persistent|持续的|3|She developed a {persistent} cough.|她开始持续咳嗽。
preliminary|初步的|3|The {preliminary} results look promising.|初步结果看起来很有希望。
preserve|保存|3|We should {preserve} important historical records.|我们应该保存重要的历史记录。
proportion|比例|3|A large {proportion} of students chose this course.|很大比例的学生选择了这门课程。
reluctant|不情愿的|3|He was {reluctant} to discuss the issue.|他不愿意讨论这个问题。
substantial|大量的|3|The project requires a {substantial} investment.|这个项目需要大量投资。
sustainable|可持续的|3|The city is working toward {sustainable} development.|这座城市正在努力实现可持续发展。
undergo|经历|3|The building will {undergo} major repairs.|这座建筑将进行大规模维修。
undermine|削弱|3|False information can {undermine} public trust.|虚假信息会削弱公众信任。
valid|有效的|3|You must present a {valid} ticket.|你必须出示有效的票。
withdraw|撤回|3|They decided to {withdraw} the proposal.|他们决定撤回这项提议。
